# Claim the £1,000 trading allowance, or deduct your real expenses?

> Free UK trading allowance calculator: enter your side-hustle income and expenses to see whether to claim the £1,000 allowance or deduct costs, with the income tax and Class 4 NIC either way. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
